args.description: from hanging by his raised hands, he pulls his chest up to the height of his hands, swings one knee up, pushes himself up and stands up in the fighting stance; nothing is drawn around him: no log, no bar, no branch, no cliff, no rock, no wall, no platform, no ground. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no effect, no motion streak, no speed lines, no trail behind the limbs or the weapon, no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture. Every frame shows the arms, legs and weapon clearly in a crisp pose, never blurred.
args.subject_description: a young man with messy white hair and blue eyes, a long white coat with grey tails, a black shirt, black trousers and grey boots
args.initial_pose: hanging from his raised hands, arms stretched straight up, legs dangling, empty background above the hands
